key_signals: 1 Pathogenic and 2 VUS classifications in this chunk
ClinVar labels 2 variants as Pathogenic, 1 as not provided
All variants have low but non-rare gnomAD AF (0.00029–0.00348)
BRCA2 frameshift variant classified Pathogenic with strong PVS1 evidence
GBA missense variant: ClinVar Pathogenic but engine calls VUS (PP3, PP5)
HBB missense variant: VUS with conflicting in silico predictions (SIFT D, PolyPhen B)
No variants reach very rare AF < 1e-4 or common AF > 5%

notable_variants.why_notable: Canonical BRCA2 frameshift with strong loss-of-function evidence (PVS1) and ClinVar Pathogenic, low gnomAD AF
ClinVar Pathogenic missense variant but classified as VUS here; supportive in silico (SIFT D, PolyPhen P) and PP3, PP5 criteria
Sickle-cell-associated HBB missense variant with moderate AF and mixed in silico predictions; ClinVar significance not provided and only PP3 applied

caveats: Classifications are from a simplified engine and may differ from full ACMG assessments or clinical reports
ClinVar Pathogenic labels (e.g., GBA) are not automatically adopted, leading to tension between databases and engine calls
Allele frequencies are modest and context-dependent; carrier status and disease prevalence are not evaluated here
In silico predictions (SIFT, PolyPhen) are supportive but not definitive and can disagree, especially for missense variants
No segregation, functional study, or phenotype data are incorporated into these classifications
Interpretations should not be used for clinical decision-making without comprehensive review
